findings.title: AbortSignal capture can execute getters and authenticate counterfeit native state
findings.counterexample: Node22 native getter reports aborted=true/reason=actual-abort, while own shadow properties produce captured aborted=false/reason=null. A fresh genuine public reference tool turn using this provider-boundary negative exits 0 and measureToolTurn accepts it. A prototype-forged nonbranded signal is also accepted. Signal and Error reason getters execute once.
findings.fix: Reject state/reason shadows and forged brands, read signal state through captured intrinsic AbortSignal getters, inspect supported Error reason data descriptors before reading fields, and add rejecting getter/prototype/shadow-state controls at the adapter boundary.

findings.title: The stated 4KiB fixture string cap is enforced as UTF-16 length
findings.counterexample: The known ASCII fixture with message replaced by "é" repeated 4096 has 8192 UTF-8 bytes, passes validateToolCase and completes the public CVG path with 2 model calls and 1 echo body. The 64KiB aggregate does not enforce the per-string byte limit.
findings.fix: Require Buffer.byteLength(s,"utf8") <= 4096 for each fixture string before engine execution, retain the 65536-byte fixture bound, and test multibyte boundary cases in both public entry paths.

limitations: Only SPEC0213 bounded test-support was reviewed; no global T2 gates, public API/schema, production or build authority.
Reference 16 events versus CVG 3 events and full session lifecycle equivalence remain NOT_VERIFIED.
CVG step sideEffecting=true versus descriptor sideEffect=NONE remains an observed difference, not resolved semantics.
Nine exported runtime artifacts authenticated; source-to-lib correspondence and complete transitive closure remain NOT_VERIFIED.
No wider policy/capability correctness or full parity is established; original 36-goal/34-open scope remains unproven.
Reviewer did not independently run repository-wide type/lint/integration/PG/E2E/coverage/certification gates.

Output-only containment was violated by reviewer Vite/Vitest cache writes through the inherited whole-node_modules symlink; confirmed results-cache metadata and corrective actions are recorded. No source/history contents were read from that cache.

Two mock-based child-fault attempts did not intercept the spawn and are excluded as fault evidence; the subsequent separately named runner copies use real injected child exits/timeouts and retain all failures.
